decision.reasoning_trace: I selected the consideration set based on the products with the highest ratings and most reviews, ensuring a good balance between quality and customer satisfaction. The Garmin Instinct 2 (prod_smartwatches_068) was chosen as the final product due to its high rating of 4.6, numerous reviews (908), and its features such as heart rate monitoring, GPS, and water resistance, making it a well-rounded smartwatch that meets the needs of fitness enthusiasts and everyday users alike.
